<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>SD4SP Project - Hub</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../assets/css/style.css"> <style>
        .project-header { text-align: center; margin-bottom: 40px; }
        .main-figure { width: 100%; max-width: 800px; border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); margin: 20px auto; display: block; }
        .app-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; margin-top: 40px; }
        .app-card { border: 1px solid #ddd; padding: 20px; border-radius: 10px; text-align: center; transition: 0.3s; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; }
        .app-card:hover { border-color: #2980b9; box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); transform: translateY(-5px); }
        .btn { display: inline-block; padding: 10px 20px; background: #2980b9; color: white; border-radius: 5px; text-decoration: none; margin-top: 15px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

<main class="container">
    <div class="project-header">
        <h1>Project SD4SP</h1>
        <p>Stratospheric Dynamics for Surface Prediction</p>
    </div>

    <section id="description">
        <p>This project explores the coupling between the stratosphere and the troposphere to improve sub-seasonal to seasonal predictions...</p>
        
        <img src="../assets/images/sd4sp-figure.png" alt="SD4SP Coupling Mechanism" class="main-figure">
        
        <p>The figure above illustrates the main mechanisms we analyze, focusing on planetary wave activity and zonal wind reversals.</p>
    </section>

    <section class="app-grid">
        <div class="app-card">
            <h3>🌪️ SSW Diagnostic Tool</h3>
            <p>Calculate SSW events using different criteria and visualize surface impacts.</p>
            <a href="ssw-app.html" class="btn">Launch SSW App</a>
        </div>
        
        <div class="app-card">
            <h3>📈 QBO Analysis Tool</h3>
            <p>Monitor the Quasi-Biennial Oscillation and its teleconnections.</p>
            <a href="qbo-app.html" class="btn" style="background: #27ae60;">Launch QBO App</a>
        </div>
    </section>
</main>

</body>
</html>
